title: 2000 AMC 10 Problem 24
statement: Let \(f\) be a function for which \(f\left(\dfrac{x}{3}\right) = x^2 + x + 1.\) Find the sum of all values of \(z\) for which \(f(3z) = 7.\)

solutions.text:
To evaluate \(f(3z),\) set \(\dfrac{x}{3} = 3z,\) so \(x = 9z.\) Then \[ \begin{aligned} f(3z) &= (9z)^2 + 9z + 1 \\ &= 81z^2 + 9z + 1. \end{aligned} \]

Setting this equal to \(7\) gives \(81z^2 + 9z - 6 = 0.\)

By the sum-of-roots formula, the sum of the values of \(z\) is \(-\dfrac{9}{81} = -\dfrac19.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: This gives a quadratic in \(z;\) use the sum-of-roots formula \(-\dfrac{b}{a}\)
